metadata.description: wmux Claude Code integrations — hook bridges and future usage meters.

plugins.name: wmux-claude-integration
plugins.description: Deterministic Claude Code → wmux notifications via PostToolUse / Stop / SubagentStop / SessionStart hooks. Replaces wmux's regex-based agent detector with 100%-accurate hook signals when installed.

plugins.name: wmux-turn-signals
plugins.description: Claude Code mod (2.1.296+): reports an interrupted turn (Esc / Ctrl+C), which fires no classic Stop hook, so the wmux pane settles instead of staying 'running'. Use alongside the classic hooks.
